name: laptopia
description: Laptopia — a MERN e-commerce storefront with a role-based admin
//: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace. Workspaces consolidate to a single root
lock file, which breaks three things that already work and are tested:
both Dockerfiles (they build from ./backend and ./frontend and run npm ci
against a local lock), the CI cache keys, and Railway/Vercel's root-directory
setting. This root package.json exists only to hold the shared tooling and
to run both apps from one place.
Revisit if a shared package (e.g. Zod schemas used by both) is ever added.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
